title: C08 IMDb single-platform review value and safety comparison
prerequisites: I01: verify a product actually supplies licensed individual IMDb user reviews; ratings and AI summaries are not substitutes.
I02/I03: independently confirm catalog-to-IMDb identities and implement the bounded configured source adapter.
Freeze 10 films and all acceptance inputs before live execution; retain unavailable/failed films rather than replacing them after seeing results.
Acquire permitted review text and record actual retrieval/update times, review IDs, authors, original URLs, usage basis, freshness and provenance.
Human reviewers establish quote-support and spoiler gold decisions from actual permitted excerpts; no fabricated reference answers.

A.description: Metadata and existing template reasons only.

B.description: Same metadata, candidates and order, enriched only with licensed, cleared IMDb excerpts and scoped deterministic opinion output.

controls: Use identical film slots, metadata snapshot, queries, constraints, candidate IDs and ranking for both versions.
Do not let review availability alter candidate selection or baseline facts for this value comparison.
Use neutral display labels X/Y; keep the hidden A/B mapping outside participant-facing material.
Counterbalance first-view order across tasks and reviewers, and freeze the schedule before scores are collected.
For controlled failure tasks, apply the labelled fault to B's review evidence only; do not report it as a real provider failure.
A difference in acquisition, candidates, ranking or metadata must be reported as a protocol deviation, not attributed to review quality.

required_roles: A human reviewer verifies each published quote and its exact same-film source binding.
A human reviewer checks spoiler clearance for the displayed excerpt and conclusion.
Actual trial users rate decision help; agent-generated scores are not user trial evidence.
human_review.reference_policy: Store human gold decisions and actual permitted excerpts in ignored local artifacts; never infer gold from output being evaluated.

coverage.rule: At least two usable distinct records/authors per film after identity, licence, freshness, spoiler and duplicate checks. Failure or missing material remains in the denominator.

quality_decisions: Report quote support, spoiler and scope failures separately from usefulness scores.
Preserve all missing/failed/uncertain cases; do not count a conservative fallback as successful review coverage.
Report paired preference counts and the number of actual human respondents. Do not claim general user value from synthetic or insufficient trials.
Define human decision thresholds before execution; this protocol does not set a passing result.
measurement.cost_policy: Unknown until measured or checked against provider billing; never substitute zero for missing cost.

outputs.secret_policy: No credentials, raw personal interviews, user tokens or personal database in Git.
outputs.signoff_policy: C08 human review/user trial and M12 another-physical-computer signoff remain separate. This protocol does not sign for any member.
